name: codenudge
description: Learn to debug with progressive AI hints, reviewed fixes, and step-by-step project guidance.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The CodeNudge panel and settings are available in Restricted Mode. Terminal watching and AI analysis require trusting the folder.

codingBuddy.autoWatch.description: Automatically check completed terminal runs using files identified in the opened folder and relevant project context. Code and output are sent to your selected AI provider. Pause this in the CodeNudge settings menu.

codingBuddy.provider.description: Provider that receives your coding context in Debug and Project mode. Store keys with CodeNudge: Set API Key. Ollama/custom endpoints allow an optional key.

codingBuddy.models.gemini.description: Gemini model with structured-output support. Model availability depends on your account.

codingBuddy.models.openai.description: OpenAI model with Responses API structured-output support.

codingBuddy.models.groq.description: Groq-hosted model with strict structured-output support.

codingBuddy.models.anthropic.description: Claude API model with structured-output support. Uses an Anthropic API key, not a Claude chat subscription.

codingBuddy.models.openrouter.description: OpenRouter model ID supporting JSON schema. OpenRouter routes the request to a compatible model host.

codingBuddy.models.deepseek.description: DeepSeek API model supporting JSON output. CodeNudge validates replies locally.

codingBuddy.models.mistral.description: Mistral API model supporting custom structured outputs.

codingBuddy.models.ollama.description: Model already downloaded in your local Ollama installation. CodeNudge does not install or download models.

codingBuddy.models.custom.description: Exact model ID served by your custom OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.

codingBuddy.endpoints.ollama.description: Full Ollama chat request URL. This server receives coding context; an optional saved Ollama key is sent here. HTTPS, or HTTP on loopback only. No URL credentials/query/fragment.

codingBuddy.endpoints.custom.description: Full OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL, for example LM Studio or a hosted service. This server receives coding context and your optional custom key. HTTPS, or HTTP on loopback only. No URL credentials/query/fragment.

codingBuddy.customFormat.description: Output format supported by your custom server. Use JSON object only if JSON schema is unsupported; CodeNudge still rejects unusable replies. No automatic fallback.

codingBuddy.animateCharacter.description: Animate the CodeNudge character while idle, thinking and celebrating. Reduced-motion preferences are always respected.

codingBuddy.confetti.description: Celebrate a solved issue with confetti. Reduced-motion preferences are always respected.
